facts.value: The Transfer Achievement Grant combines all federal grants and institutional aid up to the eligible amount, depending on your Student Aid Index from the FAFSA. Pell Grants, university grants, and any institutional scholarships (such as RaiseMe, Earn to Learn, and the Phi Theta Kappa scholarship) are included in the Transfer Achievement Grant amount.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Eligible students must be admitted to ASU no later than the first day of classes for the term they applied for.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Students are encouraged to complete their steps to apply and FAFSA by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Financial aid packaging for admitted students typically begins in March for fall admits and October for spring admits.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Expect a financial aid package that includes the Transfer Achievement Grant approximately 4–6 weeks after completing your financial aid file.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: If classified as Non-Resident and would like to petition for reclassification, contact the Residency Classification office after reviewing the residency requirements.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Current ASU students are ineligible to be considered for the grant.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Students admitted spring 2026 or earlier must be an Arizona resident for tuition purposes, a transfer student from an Arizona community college, have a minimum 3.50 cumulative transfer GPA, demonstrate financial need as determined by the FAFSA, and have submitted an ASU admission application by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: The grant amount varies each year and is typically awarded in the fall semester.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: For those awarded the Transfer Achievement Award in Spring 2026 or earlier, the award can be renewed for a total of four consecutive semesters (excluding summers) by completing 24 ASU credit hours with a 2.50 or higher ASU cumulative GPA and submitting a FAFSA each year that demonstrates continued financial need.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Students are provided one extra semester past their admit term to enroll. If a transfer student admitted for fall 2026 is able to enroll until spring 2027 without needing to reapply.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Requests for deferment must be submitted at least two weeks before the start of your admit term.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Students are not allowed to enroll at another postsecondary institution during their deferment period.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: The Transfer Achievement Grant is available to any Arizona resident for tuition purposes who meets the eligibility criteria, regardless of whether the student enrolls on campus or online.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Contact your transfer admission team member for further assistance.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA
